question: In March 2025, who was appointed as a full-time member of NITI Aayog, after serving as Cabinet Secretary until August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Gauba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India** appointed **Rajiv Gauba** as a **full-time member** of **NITI Aayog** in **March 2025**.
 
• **Rajiv Gauba** is a **1982-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer** of the **Jharkhand cadre**.
 
• He previously served as the **Cabinet Secretary** of India, the highest-ranking bureaucratic position, for a tenure of five years from **August 2019** to **August 2024**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Rajiv Gauba.***
 
• During his career, he has held several key positions, including **Union Home Secretary** and **Secretary** in the **Ministry of Urban Development**.
 
• As **Cabinet Secretary**, he was instrumental in the implementation of major decisions such as the **bifurcation of Jammu and Kashmir** and the management of the **COVID-19 pandemic**.
